T: Never give up. Never surrender. Never skip dessert.
D: TV sci-fi actors are mistaken for real heroes by actual aliens.
P: Serve the mains when the Thermians arrive at the fan convention.
S: Fan expo smoky garlic nut mix

Mixed nuts and pretzels tossed in butter, Worcestershire, garlic and smoked paprika, slow-baked until crunchy and served warm in paper cups. Heat the oven to 140C. Melt 50g butter with 1 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika and a pinch of salt. Toss with 300g mixed nuts and 150g pretzels until coated. Spread on a lined tray and bake 30 minutes, stirring twice, until toasted and dry. Cool 10 minutes and serve in paper cups.
the planet with the rock monster
Seeded crackers broken into jagged shards, with tapenade of black olives, capers, anchovies, garlic and lemon blitzed coarse.

Soft pink marshmallows made with fresh raspberry purée, cut into cubes and rolled in icing sugar and cornflour, sweet, tangy and wobbly. Blitz and sieve 150g raspberries. Sprinkle 20g powdered gelatine over 100ml of the purée to bloom. Boil 300g caster sugar, 2 tbsp glucose syrup and 100ml water to 120C. Melt the gelatine mix and pour it into a mixer bowl, then pour in the hot syrup with the beaters running and whisk 10 minutes until thick and fluffy. Spread in a lined 20cm tin dusted with icing sugar and cornflour. Set 4 hours, then cut and roll in more dusting.
M: Beef and bean chilli simmered 90 minutes with onion, chilli and tomato, sour cream and cheddar.

Toasted triple-decker of roast turkey, crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo, cut into quarters and pinned with toothpicks, salted chips on the side. Bake 800g frozen chips at 220C for 20 minutes and salt them. Grill 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Toast 12 slices white bread and spread with mayo. Build each sandwich as toast, 100g sliced turkey and lettuce, toast, 2 rashers bacon and sliced tomato, toast. Pin each with 4 toothpicks and cut into quarters. Serve with the chips.
W: by Grabthar's hammer, you will have seconds
Fudgy brownies with melted dark chocolate and butter, baked at 175C for 25 minutes, pulled while the centre still wobbles.
K: the colours of the NSEA Protector

Blue curaçao syrup, pineapple and fresh lime topped with fizzy lemonade over ice, finished with a pineapple wedge and a cocktail cherry. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Add 30ml non-alcoholic blue curaçao syrup, 60ml pineapple juice and a squeeze of lime to each. Top each with 150ml cold lemonade and stir gently so it stays bright blue. Garnish with a pineapple wedge and a cocktail cherry on a pick.

s.note: the planet with the rock monster
s.how: Pulse 200g pitted black olives with 1 tbsp capers, 3 anchovies, a garlic clove, lemon juice and 3 tbsp olive oil until coarse. Break a packet of seeded crackers into jagged shards and serve with the tapenade.

m.how: Brown 800g beef mince with 1 onion and 2 tbsp chilli powder. Add 2 tins crushed tomatoes and 2 drained tins kidney beans and simmer 90 minutes until thick. Serve in bowls topped with sour cream and grated cheddar.

w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 80g flour and 30g cocoa. Bake in a lined tin at 175C for 25 minutes, pulling it out while the centre still wobbles. Cool before cutting.
